summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting execution of a €250 million second-tranche share buyback under a ~€3.5 billion multi-year program extending to 2030. The filing details daily purchases on Euronext Milan from April 20-24, 2026, totaling 58,000 shares at an average price of €307.52 per share (excluding fees), for aggregate consideration of ~€17.8 million. Since the program's start on Jan 5, 2026, Ferrari has repurchased 982,482 shares for ~€290.4 million. Treasury holds 9.03% of shares (9.41% including special voting shares), pending cancellation approved at the April 15 AGM. No advisor is named. What to watch: continued execution pace and potential ASR (accelerated share repurchase) given the multi-year authorization.
